title: German Apple Strudel Crumble
description: A twist on the classic German dessert, adding a crunchy almond crumble topping.

ingredients.name: almond paste
ingredients.notes: make sure to soften the almond paste before using

ingredients.name: sliced apples
ingredients.notes: any variety of apple, peeled and sliced

instructions: Roll out the Australian flaky pastry to a large rectangle.
In a bowl, mix together the almond paste, sliced apples, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Arrange the apple mixture on one half of the pastry rectangle.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the apple mixture and press edges to seal.
Crumble the almond crumble topping over the pastry.
Dot the top with melted unsalted butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream if desired.
